0.0: Hello! Welcome to the world of Titan. Starting a new character in a new world is like starting with a fresh slate, isn't it? Er, something like that.\r\nAnyway, since you're starting a new adventure, I have an interesting proposal for you. Want to hear it?

yes.0: If you reach Level 70 in Titan by January 23, you can get a #b#t1003206##k! There's not much time left, so you should get to it! Hurry up! There's no time to sit around!\r\n#i1003206# #t1003206#

no.0: It really is an interesting proposal! You sure you don't want to hear it?

1.0: Wow! You really reached Level 70? Honestly, I didn't expect that. All right... A promise is a promise. Here's your #t1003206#.

yes.0: You've got spirit, but I wonder if you will become the hero Titan needs...

default.0: I told you I would give you a #b#t1003206##k when you reached #bLevel 70#k... I always keep my promises, so don't worry about it! Just come see me after you have reached Level 70.
